stories.title: Rescue Teams Save Woman After 36 Hours Trapped in Colombia Earthquake Rubble
stories.summary: A 32-year-old woman was rescued alive after being trapped for 36 hours under the rubble of a collapsed building in Pereira, Colombia, following a 7.4-magnitude earthquake. Rescuers located her 10 hours before successfully reaching her, as they continue to search for more survivors amid the devastation.

stories.title: David Crowley Wins Wisconsin Democratic Primary, Set to Face Tom Tiffany
stories.summary: David Crowley, the Milwaukee County executive, has won the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, defeating progressive candidate Francesca Hong. Crowley, who was backed by Governor Tony Evers, will face Republican Representative Tom Tiffany in the upcoming November election. This victory marks a notable shift in the Democratic primary landscape, as Crowley represents a more moderate stance compared to Hong's democratic socialist platform.

stories.title: Bashar al-Assad Sentenced to Death in Absentia for War Crimes
stories.summary: A Syrian court has sentenced former president Bashar al-Assad and his brother Maher to death in absentia for war crimes and crimes against humanity related to the civil war. The court's decision comes after both men were found responsible for their actions in the conflict, which has resulted in approximately 500,000 deaths. The two brothers are currently believed to be in Moscow.

This operation was prompted by an Iranian assassination threat. The elaborate ruse involved hiding Trump in an airport catering container to ensure his safety while transitioning between flights.

stories.title: Zhu Rongji, Influential Former Premier of China, Passes Away at 97
stories.summary: Zhu Rongji, the former Premier of China, has passed away at the age of 97. He played a crucial role in transforming China's economy and was instrumental in the country's entry into the World Trade Organization in 2002. Zhu is remembered for his significant contributions to economic reforms and his efforts to enhance China's global trade relations.

stories.title: Houthi Attack in Red Sea Results in Six Deaths, Including Three Pakistanis
stories.summary: An attack by Iranian-backed Houthi rebels on a vessel in the Bab el-Mandeb strait has resulted in the deaths of six individuals, including three Pakistani nationals. This incident marks the first fatalities in the Red Sea related to such attacks in over a year. In response, U.S. forces engaged a ship they claimed was attempting to breach a blockade of Iranian ports.
